$planning: Not shipped by this package. `npm run install-planning` installs the upstream repository into a project with a settings filter built from this list, so the planning skills track upstream instead of a pinned copy. This list is the single source for that filter.
$execution: Not shipped either. The executors run under Codex and Claude, both of which install these upstream skills themselves, and the task text names them instead of handing over a path: shipping a second copy made the executor load two revisions of one skill at once. Every name here is a name `ROLE_SKILLS` in extensions/lib/brief.ts actually writes.

excluded.$executor-provides: The executor's own install provides it, and no role names it: the task text names only the skills a role uses. Add it to ROLE_SKILLS in extensions/lib/brief.ts to have the fleet ask for it.
excluded.$project-scaffold: Project scaffold. The executor installs it when a ticket calls for it.
excluded.engineering/implement: Its six instructions are already covered: the brief copies the ticket, the contract forces real test numbers, and the task text asks for a commit. The sixth invokes the upstream review skill inside the run that wrote the code, which is what the cross-harness review replaces.
excluded.engineering/ask-matt: A router into the execution set. Pi refuses the execution set, so the router would point at skills pi does not have.
excluded.engineering/implement-spec: Runs its own fleet: implementer subagents, worktrees, and a frontier. Two orchestrators on one repo fight over the same branches.
excluded.engineering/wayfinder: Its ticket types invoke research and prototype, which are execution skills. Revisit once the decision-ticket flow is wanted.
excluded.productivity/handoff: Writes a session handoff document. Pi's own session log already carries this.
excluded.productivity/writing-for-agents: Writing guidance for agent-facing text. No fleet role.
excluded.in-progress/chief-of-staff: Needs a scheduler primitive pi does not have.
excluded.in-progress/loop-me: Overlaps the fleet skill's own loop.
excluded.misc/git-guardrails-claude-code: Installs a Claude Code hook. This package carries its own guard, which also covers stash and amend.
excluded.misc/migrate-to-shoehorn: One-off codemod. The executor runs it from a ticket.
